eps.t: It's Always Love That Saves the World
eps.ov: Leon's hopes for a peaceful life are shattered when he's appointed to be one of the Saint's guards.

eps.t: Do You Enjoy the Aesthetics of Destruction?
eps.ov: Leon and his companions head to an elf island in search of treasure.
The expedition is successful, but Leon's problems begin before he can even make it back to the academy.
Leon is arrested for treason, and Marquis Frampton and the duchy appear to be conspiring together.
Julius and the idiots attempt to rescue Leon, and Marie crumbles on the front line.

eps.t: If I Don't Like It, I'll Just Run
eps.ov: Leon says he can defeat the invaders, but only if he's made supreme commander.
Leon and Marie realize they know each other from their past lives, and Leon confronts Marquis Frampton.
Marie and the idiots are recruited to activate the royal ship, and Leon prepares for war.
Leon's forces engage the guardians of the sky and sea.
The light unleashed from the royal ship robs everyone of their will to fight, except for Vandel.
Olivia, Angelica, and Marie make a final desperate attempt to stop the fighting.

eps.t: This World Is Tough for Mobs
eps.ov: The war between the kingdom and principality ends, and Leon looks forward to a quiet and relaxing life.
